en.text:
Weapon Hits grant Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy. Does not require Direct Hits.

Ability Energy gains on Hits by weapon:
• Trustee: 0.35%
• Posterity: 0.45%
• Commemoration: 0.4%
• Heritage: 0.85%
• Succession: 1.5%
• Bequest: 2% (Grenade and Class Ability only)
